question: Should this protection become an automatically installed pre-push hook for contributor worktrees, or remain a documented voluntary diagnostic command?
rationale: The PR’s security objective requires automatic enforcement, but automatically installing a hook is a contributor-workflow policy choice that should be explicit rather than inferred from a package script.

options.title: Install an enforced pre-push hook
options.body: Wire the guard through the existing hook installer, preserve the manual command for diagnostics, and prove safe and unsafe push behavior.

options.title: Keep it voluntary and narrow its claims
options.body: Keep the command and documentation as a manual local hygiene check, but remove language promising that it intercepts publication before push.

recommendation.title: Install an enforced pre-push hook
recommendation.body: Wire the guard through the existing hook installer, preserve the manual command for diagnostics, and prove safe and unsafe push behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposed implementation and can supply the missing lifecycle wiring or narrow the PR’s intended scope; current-main scripts ownership was not available in the supplied evidence.
